changes: Added the farm link tracker: `/channels` configures watched video, world, and schematic channels per guild.
Added passive link detection in watched channels, including `📪DN :` parsing and video embed titles stored verbatim.
Added `/farm add`, `/farm remove`, `/farm list`, `/farm suggestions`, and `/farm export` for manager-only farm management.
Added staged farm suggestions so passive detections are confirmed by a manager before entering the live dataset.
Added `/farm export` posting a `.jsonl` file with a rolling two-generation changelog (changes.current and changes.previous).
Added `/farm list` pagination with Previous/Next buttons, type filtering, and newest-first ordering by creation date.
Added 20 fixed farm types as command choices, plus automatic video title fetching from oEmbed/OpenGraph for manual links.
Added the public `/dn` lookup command that DMs a farm embed linking to its page, with a persistent 2-minute cooldown per user.
